verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at appwrite.io/llms.txt written for coding agents and a docs.md index pointing to a nested documentation llms.txt. First-party docs add raw Markdown for every page via a .md suffix, a Copy page button, open-source agent Skills files, and an MCP server that gives LLMs access to the docs. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://appwrite.io/llms.txt # Appwrite
For the full nested page index, see the documentation llms.txt.
You can access any documentation page as raw Markdown by appending `.md` to the URL.
Skills are open-source Markdown files that give AI agents deep knowledge of Appwrite SDKs and services.
Appwrite offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows LLMs to directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs.
